title: Thok It To 'Em (saga)
start: Find scribbled notes while raiding the 30-35 abandoned floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.
prereq_other: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

items.t: Ring of kinship to find scribbled notes

rewards.t: Abridged: An abridged book, which when read gives:
Unabridged: Together with the above rewards, an unabridged book, which when read gives:

steps.t: Find the scribbled note while raiding the 30-35 Abandoned 2 floors of Daemonheim, and recover memory of it.
Talk to Skaldrun and ask him to tell you a story. [Chat: 1 Forgot what he says here › 1 Tell me a story]

sub.t: You need to bank everything, including the ring of kinship.
If the option to start this saga is not available, that means you haven't found the scribbled note on the floor inside Daemonheim.

steps.t: Kill Stomp like you would in a normal dungeon.
As Thok, continue down the ladder and kill The Thing with eyes.
Continue east and exorcise dark spirit to the east.
Kill the 2 enemies in the next room and continue south.
Kill the 3 enemies in the next room and continue east.
Pick up the silver curvy thing to the southeast and return back to the starting room to unlock the silver wibbly thing.
Activate the big rock and kill all the squishy ghosts until the monolith is fully charged then continue north.
Head west and kill the coward with a bow.
Once he has been killed, run back to the room where the Silver curvy thing was found (marked by the summoning icon on the minimap).
Next, continue through the rooms to the east, north and east again.
Take the Red block from the floor.

sub.t: If additional food is required, Crunchy rune rocks can be acquired from the supply table.

steps.t: Run back through the rooms: west, south, and 2 more rooms west.
Enter the southern door, then go west by unlocking the red wibbly thing.
Attempt to imbue the tiles 3 times. On the third try, Thok will manage to imbue all the tiles correctly.
Take the blue pointed thing in the northwestern corner of the room.
Go into the next room with the bulky warrior. Kill him and move out of the direction he is facing if he prepares to charge.
Once the bulky warrior has been defeated, return to the room with the summoning icon indicated on the minimap.
Unlock the Blue wibbly thing.
Upon entering the room, take a pickaxe from the rock and equip it.
Attack the Armoured cow thing until its armour is destroyed.
Continue the fight with Thok's sword.
After the fight, go back to the room with the supply table (North-East side).
In the room to the north, kill the Ramokee skinweaver first, then move on to killing the other ramokees.
Moving to the next room, talk to Thok-blocker until it allows you to enter the room.
Pick up the Orange stick thing in the southeast corner of the room, and return to the room to the east.
Unlock the Orange wibbly thing to face Gobby demon.
Thok should be able to kill the demon before any of its attacks are used. However, if portals appear on the ground, move away from them and continue attacking.
Go back through the door and take the door to the west.
Kill Warped Gulega. Avoid the 1 lifepoint attack by moving 1 square away when tentacles appear on the ground.
p: Thok fights the Coward with Bow

steps.t: Talk to Pretty Lass. [Chat: 1 [Tell her about Marmaros] › 2 [Take her to Marmaros]]
Kill the Walking ice cube.

sub.t: Every 33% damage dealt it will encase itself in ice and running around the dungeon will avoid the player from being hit.

p: Thok utilising a special attack from his sword.
Thok attacking thing with eyes with a special attack.

get_inside.text: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.
pic: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.

get_inside.text: Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor.
Teleporting to Daemonheim Dig Site by using the dig sites map located in the Archaeology Guild (with level 73 Archaeology after rescuing Skaldrun).
pic: The place where players arrive if they travel to Daemonheim by boat.

get_inside.text: Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.

Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to the Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers.
Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.
